exposure: QR code-based patient education on postpartum contraception options
outcome: Establishment of postpartum contraception plans upon discharge
cohort: The cohort included patients admitted to an antepartum unit who delivered during the same admission, analyzed over a year before and a year after QR code implementation.
finding: The implementation of QR code-based patient education significantly increased the proportion of patients establishing a postpartum birth control plan upon discharge and led to more Black patients choosing permanent contraception.
